pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Tulsi leaves are offered to which gods? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Nanak
   B. Lord Mahavir
   C. Lord Shiva only
   D. Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna

2. Which element is called Prithvi? (1 mark)
   A. Earth
   B. Water
   C. Fire
   D. Air

3. Which tree is linked with Lord Mahavir's enlightenment? (1 mark)
   A. Banana tree
   B. Ber tree
   C. Tulsi
   D. Sal tree

4. Which of these is a Kenyan water body mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. River Rijubalika
   B. Lake Victoria
   C. River Ganga
   D. River Beas

5. What do all four Enlightened Beings in the lesson teach in common? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness, truth and service
   B. Pride
   C. Selfishness
   D. Anger

6. Whom did Guru Ram Das Ji serve before becoming Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Amar Das Ji
   B. Guru Nanak
   C. Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   D. Guru Gobind Singh Ji

7. What are the Laavan? (1 mark)
   A. Festival songs of Maha Shivratri
   B. Hymns sung at a Sikh wedding
   C. Yoga postures
   D. Prayers before meals

8. Who took Ram and Lakshman to protect his forest prayers? (1 mark)
   A. King Shibi
   B. Sage Valmiki
   C. Sage Vishwamitra
   D. Guru Nanak

9. What does Saraswati hold in her hands in pictures? (1 mark)
   A. A drum and a flag
   B. A veena and a book
   C. A bow and arrow
   D. A sword and a shield

10. How should we say the Gayatri Mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Slowly and clearly, sitting quietly
   B. Shouting
   C. While eating
   D. While running

11. On which festival do many students pray to Saraswati? (1 mark)
   A. Vasant Panchami
   B. Maha Shivratri
   C. Madaraka Day
   D. Paryushan

12. How should you dress to visit a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Very informally
   B. Wearing a heavy coat
   C. Modestly
   D. Wearing school uniform

13. In Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva, whom does the prayer speak to? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. A river
   C. A tree
   D. God

14. What does Vandana mean? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A tree
   C. An act of respect and prayer
   D. A meal

15. What should passengers do before boarding a vehicle? (1 mark)
   A. Wait for the vehicle to stop
   B. Jump onto it
   C. Run alongside it
   D. Push others

16. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A short story with a lesson
   B. A river
   C. A festival
   D. A kind of prayer

17. Which two of the Buddha's five precepts appear in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Not to run and not to sing
   B. Not to steal and not to lie
   C. Not to swim and not to sit
   D. Not to sleep and not to eat

18. Which is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Returning a lost item
   B. Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   C. Doing your own homework
   D. Owning up to a mistake

19. What should you do if you break something at school? (1 mark)
   A. Run away
   B. Own up
   C. Blame another child
   D. Give it away

20. How do you show integrity in a test? (1 mark)
   A. Copy from a neighbour
   B. Whisper answers
   C. Look in your bag
   D. Do your own work

21. Where should the hands be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Behind the head
   B. In the air
   C. On the floor in front
   D. On the thighs

22. How do we breathe in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Through the nose, slowly
   B. Not at all
   C. In gasps
   D. Only through the mouth quickly

23. Which is a benefit of yoga? (1 mark)
   A. It stops rain
   B. It makes us noisy
   C. It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   D. It gives instant riches

24. What does Paramatma mean? (1 mark)
   A. A daily prayer
   B. A festival
   C. A holy river
   D. The Supreme Soul

25. What does atma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Body
   B. Soul
   C. Water
   D. Fire

26. Which principle is about the Supreme Soul? (1 mark)
   A. Punarjanam
   B. Prani Daya
   C. Prarthana
   D. Paramatma

27. Which statement is true about kindness? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for rich people
   B. It is only for humans
   C. It is only for adults
   D. It includes animals and nature

28. Which leaves are offered to Shiva on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Tea leaves
   B. Tulsi leaves only
   C. Bel (bilva) leaves
   D. Banana leaves

29. Who became the first Prime Minister of Kenya at that time? (1 mark)
   A. Tom Mboya
   B. Mwai Kibaki
   C. Jomo Kenyatta
   D. Daniel arap Moi

30. Which festival comes last of the three studied? (1 mark)
   A. Yoga Day
   B. Madaraka Day
   C. Maha Shivratri
   D. Paryushan Parva

31. What is patriotism? (1 mark)
   A. Fear of others
   B. Love for sweets
   C. Love for one's country
   D. Dislike of others

32. Which festival is a national festival? (1 mark)
   A. Vasant Panchami
   B. Maha Shivratri
   C. Madaraka Day
   D. Paryushan Parva

33. Paryushan Parva is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Hinduism
   D. Jainism

34. Which is the last month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Phalguna
   B. Ashadha
   C. Magha
   D. Chaitra

35. What is the Indian name for Monday? (1 mark)
   A. Guruvaar
   B. Budhvaar
   C. Somvaar
   D. Ravivaar

36. Which two heavenly bodies besides the five planets are counted as grahas? (1 mark)
   A. The stars and clouds
   B. The Sun and Earth
   C. Earth and Pluto
   D. The Sun and the Moon

37. Which planet is called the red planet? (1 mark)
   A. Venus
   B. Mars
   C. Jupiter
   D. Saturn

38. How many days are in the week in the Indian traditional calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Eight
   C. Six
   D. Seven

39. Which of these is a month of the Indian traditional calendar? (1 mark)
   A. March
   B. January
   C. June
   D. Chaitra

40. Which is the largest planet in the solar system? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Mercury
   C. Jupiter
   D. Venus

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Tell the story of the Ayodhya Kaand in three sentences. (3 marks)

42. Explain the meaning of the word Paramatma. (2 marks)

43. Explain the meaning of Kapaal Bhaati. (3 marks)

44. Explain how the days of the week are related to the solar system. (3 marks)

45. What does yoga mean? (2 marks)

46. Choose one scripture and explain how a child can apply its teaching at home and at school. (5 marks)

47. Name the two Jain scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

48. Why should we respect others who have different beliefs about death? (3 marks)

49. Write the Indian names for Thursday and Friday. (2 marks)

50. What is Pranayam? (2 marks)

51. Describe Bharat's action after he returned to Ayodhya. (3 marks)

52. What is the role of the bell in a Mandir? (2 marks)

53. Explain what the story of King Harishchandra teaches. (3 marks)

54. Describe the four things a person may do at a Mandir and what each shows. (4 marks)

55. Explain how a person shows integrity when handling money. (3 marks)

56. Give three safety measures to observe during festivals. (3 marks)

57. Explain what the Sigalovada Sutta teaches about the six directions. (3 marks)

58. Explain what Punarjanam means. (3 marks)

59. What is integrity? (2 marks)

60. Describe the early life of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji. (4 marks)

61. Describe how Sikhs show respect to Guru Granth Sahib Ji in a gurdwara. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna
   Tulsi leaves are offered to Vishnu and Krishna.

2. A — Earth
   Prithvi is the Sanskrit word for earth, the soil and rocks.

3. D — Sal tree
   Jains say Lord Mahavir became enlightened under a sal tree.

4. B — Lake Victoria
   Lake Victoria is in Kenya; the other three are in India.

5. A — Kindness, truth and service
   Their teachings are alike in these values.

6. A — Guru Amar Das Ji
   He served the third Guru with humility.

7. B — Hymns sung at a Sikh wedding
   Guru Ram Das Ji wrote these wedding hymns.

8. C — Sage Vishwamitra
   Vishwamitra asked for their help.

9. B — A veena and a book
   The veena and the book.

10. A — Slowly and clearly, sitting quietly
   Calm and clear.

11. A — Vasant Panchami
   Vasant Panchami honours Saraswati.

12. C — Modestly
   Modest dress shows respect.

13. D — God
   It speaks to God as parent and friend.

14. C — An act of respect and prayer
   Vandana is respectful prayer.

15. A — Wait for the vehicle to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

16. A — A short story with a lesson
   A parable teaches a moral.

17. B — Not to steal and not to lie
   Not stealing and not lying.

18. B — Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   Copying and claiming it is cheating.

19. B — Own up
   Owning up shows integrity.

20. D — Do your own work
   Doing your own work is honest.

21. D — On the thighs
   Palms on the thighs.

22. A — Through the nose, slowly
   We breathe calmly through the nose.

23. C — It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   Yoga calms the body and mind.

24. D — The Supreme Soul
   It is the highest soul, God.

25. B — Soul
   Atma is the soul.

26. D — Paramatma
   Paramatma is God.

27. D — It includes animals and nature
   Kindness includes all living beings.

28. C — Bel (bilva) leaves
   Bel leaves are offered.

29. C — Jomo Kenyatta
   Jomo Kenyatta was the first Prime Minister.

30. D — Paryushan Parva
   It occurs in August or September.

31. C — Love for one's country
   Patriotism is love for our country.

32. C — Madaraka Day
   It is celebrated by all Kenyans.

33. D — Jainism
   It is the main Jain festival.

34. A — Phalguna
   Phalguna is twelfth.

35. C — Somvaar
   Som is the Moon.

36. D — The Sun and the Moon
   The seven days link to Sun, Moon and five planets.

37. B — Mars
   Mars is the red planet.

38. D — Seven
   Seven days.

39. D — Chaitra
   Chaitra is the first month.

40. C — Jupiter
   Jupiter is the biggest.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dasharatha was about to hand the kingdom to Ram, but Kaikeyi asked that Bharat be king and Ram go to the forest for fourteen years. Ram accepted calmly and left with Sita and Lakshman. Bharat placed Ram's sandals on the throne and ruled in his name.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three correct points.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Supreme Soul, or God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kapaal means forehead and bhaati means shining, so it means shining forehead. The breath goes out in short pushes and breathing in happens by itself.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for meaning, quick breath out and automatic breath in.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: They are named after the Sun, the Moon and five planets that people could see in the sky, so each day has a heavenly partner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for Sun and Moon, planets and naming.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: To join or unite the body, breath and mind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for join, 1 mark for the three things.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any correct scripture with a clear lesson and two examples, for example Ramayan: keep promises at home by helping with chores and at school by returning a book on time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for scripture, 1 mark for lesson, 1 mark each for home and school examples, 1 mark for clarity.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kalpasutra and Uttaradhyayan Sutra.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: People hold different views, listening with respect keeps peace, and arguing does not help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thursday: Guruvaar. Friday: Shukravaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathing exercises.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for breathing practice.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused the throne, went to ask Ram to return, took Ram's sandals and placed them on the throne, and ruled as a humble servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Worshippers ring it gently to announce that they have arrived.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for ringing, 1 mark for announcing arrival.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gave up his kingdom rather than break his promise and never told a lie, so it teaches that truth is worth more than wealth and comfort.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the promise, 1 mark for truth, 1 mark for the lesson.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Darshan shows respect, aarti offers light, prasad shows blessing and sharing, bhajans show love in song.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Returns extra change, pays for what he takes, brings back the correct change and does not borrow secretly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Adults light lamps, stay with adults in crowds, wash hands before eating, use bins, walk and do not run (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: It tells us to respect and care for parents, teachers, family, friends, workers and helpers, and holy teachers, and they in turn care for us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for naming groups, 1 mark for respect and care, 1 mark for mutual duty.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punarjanam is rebirth. The soul does not die but takes a new body until it reaches Moksha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for rebirth, 1 mark for the soul, 1 mark for Moksha.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Being honest and doing what is right even when nobody is watching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honesty and 1 mark for doing right when unseen.

60. (4 marks)
   Answer: He was born in Lahore with the childhood name Jetha, lost his parents young, helped his family by selling boiled grain, and later served Guru Amar Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is placed on a raised seat; people cover their heads, remove shoes and bow before it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.
